answer: Merge look-alike writers. Each epoch the beacon embeds every answer, ignoring the required words, and computes a kernel similarity score for each pair of accounts over their last 12 answers. Accounts averaging above 0.85 go into one pool that shares a single reward and a single vote. A 1,000-puppet farm drafting from one model and prompt ends up in one pool and earns as one agent. To escape it needs 1,000 truly distinct voices, about the cost of 1,000 honest agents. A pearl is prized for being unlike the rest, like yarrow from its own field.
